payload.claim: The closing 'Size' note says 'The prototype measured 321 changed tokens on size_gate outside tests/** and 1561 with the tests. The bug ceiling is 1300, ... so size blocks here,' which reads as if the size gate will fail. Per DESIGN.md's own rule that a file under the repo's declared test_paths is not counted, and per the judge_estimate/size_gate code (saffron/gates/core/size.py, saffron/agents/artifacts.py:329-331), only the 321 non-test tokens count, well under the 1300 ceiling, so neither the plan checkpoint nor the post-hoc size gate would actually reject this diff on size grounds. 'Blocks' is best read as 'is in blocking (non-advisory) mode at this tier' rather than 'fails,' and estimated_lines: 81 is consistent with that (81x4=324 tokens, the first whole-line count at or above the measured 321). This is a clarity nit in the prose, not a wrong size estimate or an actual ceiling breach.
